learning_outcomes.text: The student analyzes existing HTML and CSS code. He/she finds syntax errors and outlines the result of this code without the help of a browser or other software program.
The student predicts the result of existing JavaScript, jQuery, and/or XML-based code without the help of a browser or other software program.
The student uses HTML and CSS to provide a website with a professional-looking layout. He/she develops a website in a high-quality manner, using a correct page structure and robust CSS techniques.
The student makes a website interactive using JavaScript and/or jQuery.
The student uses XML files and XML-based techniques to selectively display data on a website.
The student tests the website during the development process with a view to delivering a successfully working software.

syllabus_topics: XML, XSL, DTD, XML schema, XSLT
assessment_rules: The course is evaluated based on two activities: a theory exam and a lab exam. The theory exam evaluates learning outcomes (1) and (2), while the lab exam evaluates learning outcomes (3) - (6). If the student achieves a score of <7 on one of the evaluation activities, the student can achieve a maximum of 9/20 for the entire course. For resits, there are partial transfers for successful partial results within the academic year. For the lab resit, the student makes an improved version of their website and contacts the lecturer for guidance.
